title: Location
description: The full, rich representation of a physical business location. Builds on top of the Base Location schema to include discovery-centric details such as geographic coordinates, operating hours, timezone, and amenities.

hours.description: Regular weekly operating hours whose day and time values use this Location's canonical local civil-time frame. Multiple entries for the same day support split shifts.

exception_hours.description: Date-specific operating-hour exceptions, including full closures, whose date and time values use this Location's canonical local civil-time frame.

timezone.description: The Business-owned IANA Time Zone Database identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York') defining this Location's canonical local civil-time frame for all returned schedule day, time, and date fields. The Business does not vary this canonical framing by the requesting Platform's or Buyer's timezone. Required when hours or exception_hours is present.
